project_type: Full-stack rugby video analysis app - Python FastAPI backend + React TypeScript frontend
build_system: uv (Python), npm/vite (frontend), Docker Compose for orchestration
test_command: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v && cd ../frontend && npm run test -- --run
verification_instructions: 1. Run backend tests: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v. 2. Run frontend tests: cd frontend && npm run test -- --run. 3. Build frontend: cd frontend && npm run build
setup_instructions: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access to registries. No GPU available in sandbox so YOLO model download/inference won't work at runtime but unit tests mock the detector.
contribution_requirements: Hexagonal architecture (ports and adapters) with SOLID principles. Backend uses FastAPI, pydantic models, async patterns. Frontend uses Zustand stores, React functional components, TailwindCSS.
key_patterns: Backend: src/ports/ defines abstract interfaces, src/adapters/ implements them, src/cv/ has CV pipeline, src/services/ has business logic, src/api/routes/ has FastAPI routers. Frontend: src/stores/ has Zustand stores, src/components/ has React components, src/services/api.ts wraps axios calls, src/types/index.ts defines all shared types.
directory_structure: backend/src/cv/ - CV pipeline (detector, tracker, analytics, video_processor, transform, tracking_modes). backend/src/adapters/ai/ - AI providers (nvidia, openai, claude, gemini, ollama). backend/src/api/routes/ - FastAPI routes. backend/src/services/ - business logic. frontend/src/pages/ - page components. frontend/src/components/ - UI components. frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand state. frontend/src/services/ - API/WS clients.
